summary: Third consolidated daily run. News sweep of 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-22 (Federal Register API for rules, proposed rules and presidential documents, the whitehouse.gov presidential actions page, the Supreme Court orders pages, and topic searches on 21 watch items): two official developments were mapped. A CBP final rule of 2026-10-22 (91 FR 66638) moved the compliance date for formal entry of certain postal shipments to 2027-01-20 without changing the de minimis suspension (c26-03, stage holds). The Supreme Court denied a stay on 2026-10-21 in Trump v. Kingdom (No. 26A416), leaving in place a preliminary injunction against a Bureau of Prisons policy on medical care for transgender inmates; no tracked recommendation covers that policy, so it is logged as unmapped on the watch list. Executive Order 14436 of 2026-10-16 (Russia and Iran sanctions act implementation) and the women's health executive order of 2026-10-19 were read and found to bear on no tracked recommendation. Rotation: six freshness checks (c15-03, c17-07, c19-02, c19-06 and c23-01 gained evidence and were independently reviewed with no stage change; c02-08 checked without change) and four refutation checks on records counted as in effect (c03-10, c11-25, c14-16, c14-20), all of which hold. The review located a First Circuit judgment of 2026-09-24 vacating the district court's set-aside of HUD's FY2026 Continuum of Care notice and remanding (c15-03, court_status corrected to pending), and the primary 2025-01-24 Justice Department FACE Act charging memorandum (c17-07). No stage changed; counts unchanged at 627. No pending requests; the three pending leads on dhs.gov and media.defense.gov still could not be opened. About 46 of 120 searches used. Export to GitHub paused.
